reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: We had two trees felled, the stumps removed and a hedge reduced in height. Chris and the team arrived promptly at the time and date agreed. They worked very hard using appropriate safety equipment. The care of the garden and the tidy up after the work was impressive. We were delighted with the outcome as was our neighbour who has now recruited them for some work in their garden!
items.label: Which? review

items.text: We have used Chris three times now, and each time he has been fantastic. He’s taken a tree out and ground the stump down, also on two more occasions to grind out roots from other tree issues. … Very reasonable prices and great service, I’d definitely recommend and would use again if needed.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Used for reducing crowns and cutting back lots of overgrown hedges. Friendly and efficient service. Very competitive quote, flexible during work. Cleared up nicely too. Will definitely use again.
items.label: Which? review
